---
title: "Weekly gasoline prices"
format: html
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

data_url = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2025/2025-07-01/weekly_gas_prices.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(data_url, parse_dates=["date"])
```

```{python}
filtered = df[                            #Filtrar el DataFrame
    (df["fuel"] == "gasoline") &
    (df["formulation"] == "all")
]
filtered = filtered.sort_values("date")    #Ordenar por fecha

for grade, group in filtered.groupby("grade"):      #agrupar y graficar por grade
    plt.plot(group["date"], group["price"], label=grade)

plt.title("Gasoline prices over time")              #Titulos y etiquetas
plt.xlabel("Date")
plt.ylabel("Price (USD per gallon)")
plt.legend(title="Grade")
```
